# DSH Studio v0.9.14

## Fixes and polish

- Bundle OpenAI Sans Regular, Medium, and Semibold so the interface consistently renders its intended 400, 510, and 590 weights without requiring a system-installed font.
- Match the updated desktop reference with a 36 px title bar, 20 px default buttons, 22–28 px fields and selectors, a 450 px confirmation dialog, a 520 px command palette, and the corresponding 6–16 px corner radii.
- Use compact 12 px controls and 14 px dark tooltips with restrained neutral fills and focused blue edges.
- Render preset choices as neutral 16 px radios with a 6 px inverse center and stable selected-row geometry. Arrow, Home, and End keys now move selection and roving focus.
- Degrade malformed worktree replies to an empty collection instead of crashing Settings, and complete the browser fixture for startup, worktree, and preset inspection.

## Installation and limitations

- Upgrade in place or use the in-app updater. Full includes offline dependencies; Lite downloads them when needed.
- All three OpenAI Sans faces are included in both Lite and Full interface assets; no separate system installation is required.

## Verification

- Local production build, lint, 277 frontend tests at 95.1% statement coverage, 59 packaging tests, 408 Rust tests, accessibility checks, public-contract checks, and bilingual documentation checks passed.
- Browser checks covered dark and light themes, fields, the open selector, pointer and keyboard radio selection, command-palette and tooltip geometry, loaded font faces, and a clean console after a full reload.
- The release pipeline validates Lite and Full packages on Linux, Windows, and macOS, including an in-place Windows upgrade and clean uninstall, before publishing checksums and the signed updater manifest.
